note: Document diagrams; not new measurements. Payload bytes are count × C++ element size.

memory_snapshot.snapshot: scene publication, plus separately labelled post-load annotation addition
memory_snapshot.excluded: spare capacity (except the reported mesh capacity), small metadata, allocator/driver overhead, other applications, and transient upload storage

steps.title: Check supported capacity
steps.input: File size and an optional bounded capacity scan
steps.action: Check limits before large allocation.
steps.output: No early rejection; parsed counts are checked again later.
steps.note: The optional scan stops early when a sampled count is within capacity or an attribute/primitive record makes a full scan unnecessary. Process read counters report 1 MiB in the measured preflight.

steps.title: Read, decode and collect
steps.input: Buffered reads; 16 ranges; bounded raw text storage
steps.action: Convert numbers and references; collect ranges in file order.
steps.output: Positions, UVs, face references and metadata; reported chunk bytes: 4.555 GB
steps.note: RGB extras are decoded and validated, then discarded. No normals are supplied. Read and decode overlap.

steps.title: Plan shape merge
steps.input: Per-chunk counts and shape/group boundaries
steps.action: Compute global offsets and final output sizes.
steps.output: Offsets, ranges and required array lengths

steps.title: Allocate merged arrays
steps.input: Final attribute and primitive counts
steps.action: Allocate destination arrays.
steps.output: P, U, C and per-face/group metadata F

steps.title: Plan copy tasks
steps.input: Local arrays and global destination offsets
steps.action: Create independent copy and index-adjustment tasks.
steps.output: Source/destination ranges and index bases

steps.title: Copy and reconcile indices
steps.input: Numeric chunks and primitive references
steps.action: Copy attributes; convert local/relative indices to global references.
steps.output: 37.891 M positions; 38.414 M UVs; 227.316 M corners; one group
steps.note: Local chunk storage is temporary. Final output sizes in the buffer table are populated payloads, not the reported chunk-byte statistic.

chapters.title: B. Set coordinates and prepare construction buffers

steps.title: Resolve freeform records
steps.input: Parsed geometry and ordered freeform records
steps.action: Resolve any analytic control references.
steps.output: No freeform patches for this model; polygon data remains.

steps.title: Release statement records
steps.input: Records consumed by freeform resolution
steps.action: Drop numeric statement and sparse weight storage.
steps.output: P, U, C and F remain available.

steps.title: Validate primitive ranges
steps.input: Faces, line/point ranges and source counts
steps.action: Check supported counts and primitive structure.
steps.output: 75.772 M triangles; no line or point primitives

steps.title: Adopt source coordinates
steps.input: 37.891 M double XYZ records
steps.action: Move P into mesh-construction ownership.
steps.output: Ownership changes; no second XYZ array is copied.

steps.title: Choose coordinate origin
steps.input: Double XYZ values
steps.action: Validate coordinates and select a local origin.
steps.output: Origin is (0,0,0) for this model; P remains.

steps.title: Subtract the origin
steps.input: The same source position vector
steps.action: Rewrite each point as P − origin.
steps.output: Same array, updated in place; zero origin here.

steps.title: Inspect / triangulate faces
steps.input: Position table and polygon corner lists
steps.action: Split non-triangular polygons when required.
steps.output: Already triangular here; still checked. Each triangle has three corners.

steps.title: Reserve construction arrays
steps.input: Source positions move into a shared owner.
steps.action: Reserve render buffers and lookup tables.
steps.output: P is now shared; allocate primary entries, key storage and later seam buckets.
steps.note: V and M reserve from source counts, then grow because UV seams add vertices.

chapters.title: C. Convert corner references into render vertices

steps.title: Resolve and write corners
steps.input: Corner keys are (position ID, UV ID, normal ID).
steps.action: Reuse a render ID or create a vertex; write both index streams.
steps.output: 38.414 M render vertices and two 227.316 M corner index streams
steps.note: V stores float positions, normals and flipped-v UVs. I addresses V; S and M address P. Lookup tables are temporary.

chapters.title: D. Generate normals, calculate bounds and publish

steps.title: Check for complete normals
steps.input: Initial normal fields; all are zero for this input.
steps.action: Decide whether normals must be generated.
steps.output: Missing normals: generate them for this model.

steps.title: Clear normal accumulators
steps.input: The constructed render vertex array
steps.action: Set each vertex normal to zero.
steps.output: Normal fields are ready for accumulation.

steps.title: Accumulate face normals
steps.input: Three indexed render vertices per triangle
steps.action: Compute a unit face normal and add it to its three vertex normals.
steps.output: Sums of adjacent unit face normals; 75.772 M triangles processed
steps.note: Face normals are transient local values; there is no retained array of all face normals.

steps.title: Normalize vertex sums
steps.input: One sum per render vertex
steps.action: Normalize the accumulated vectors.
steps.output: Same 32-byte vertex records, ready for shading

steps.title: Calculate whole-mesh bounds
steps.input: 38.414 M float XYZ records
steps.action: Find min/max and centre; scan again for radius.
steps.output: Small float bounds value; radius uses vertex distances.

steps.title: Calculate original bounds
steps.input: For vertex i, fetch P[M[i]] and add the origin.
steps.action: Reduce precise coordinates to min/max.
steps.output: Two double XYZ values; cached for whole-mesh use

steps.title: Publish CPU geometry
steps.input_title: Draft V + I + M; shared P
steps.input: Completed render buffers, group ranges and source data S
steps.action: Validate storage and transfer its owner.
steps.output: The same arrays can be read by UI, upload and workers.
steps.note: Publication does not copy the complete mesh. S remains in SourceMeshData; P has one shared owner.

steps.title: Release construction lookups
steps.input_title: C + F + primary / key / bucket tables
steps.input: No longer needed after render IDs are written.
steps.action: Destroy parsed polygons and lookup tables.
steps.output_title: Retained P + V + I + S + M
steps.output: Temporary lookup storage is released.
steps.note: U and the empty parsed normal array are released at importer return; that destruction is not a separately timed diagram step.

chapters.title: E. Create group controls and point membership

steps.title: Calculate local group bounds
steps.input: For this group, I contains all 227.316 M corners.
steps.action: Gather float positions and reduce group bounds.
steps.output: Min/max, centre and box-based radius; no new V array

steps.title: Calculate original group bounds
steps.input: Corner → render ID → source ID → precise XYZ
steps.action: Reduce original-frame coordinates for this group.
steps.output: Two double XYZ values; G also retains display settings.
steps.note: The group pass traverses corners rather than all unique render vertices. It repeats geometry already covered by whole-mesh bounds.

steps.title: Validate upload indices
steps.input: Published immutable mesh; display feature flags
steps.action: Check capacities, index bounds and valid triangle ranges.
steps.output: Same mesh arrays; no new geometry

steps.title: Allocate membership buffers
steps.input: 38.414 M render vertices; one group
steps.action: Reserve L and initialize temporary group markers.
steps.output: L uses 32-bit vertex IDs; scratch uses size_t per vertex.

steps.title: Collect unique group vertices
steps.input: Walk corners; mark vertices already added to this group.
steps.action: Add each referenced render vertex once per group.
steps.output: 38.414 M point-to-vertex entries for the one group
steps.note: Membership scratch is released when scene preparation returns. No edge-index buffer is created with the measured default features.

steps.title: Calculate point range bounds
steps.input: Use each marker ID to find its render position.
steps.action: Validate positions and calculate group min/max.
steps.output: Small bounds used to normalize spatial keys

steps.title: Create spatial sort keys
steps.input: 38.414 M marker positions
steps.action: Interleave 10-bit coordinates into a Morton key.
steps.output: 8 bytes per point; ID retains the original mapping.

steps.title: Sort point keys
steps.input: Key array plus a same-size temporary scratch array
steps.action: Run four stable 8-bit radix passes.
steps.output: Positions have not been rewritten or quantized.

steps.title: Gather sorted point records
steps.input: Each marker ID still identifies its render vertex.
steps.action: Copy positions and IDs into Q; release keys.
steps.output: 38.414 M records; Q is 614.630 MB, L is 153.658 MB.

steps.title: Build tree and proxy samples
steps.input: Spatially ordered original points with persistent IDs
steps.action: Split ranges, reduce bounds and sample original points.
steps.output: 32,767 nodes; 4,379,823 proxy points; Q remains.
steps.note: Proxy records are sampled original points, not averaged replacements. R occupies 70.077 MB.

steps.title: Prepare navigation cuts
steps.input: Tree ranges and proxy counts
steps.action: Choose camera-independent cuts for several budgets.
steps.output: Q, R, T, L and group metadata; ready for upload and picking

chapters.title: G. Copy selected buffers to the GPU and draw

steps.title: Upload selected buffers
steps.input: CPU arrays plus prepared node ranges
steps.action: Submit incremental buffer creation/copies to the graphics backend.

steps.title: Publish the viewer scene
steps.input: CPU scene metadata and completed upload job
steps.action: Install the loaded file into the viewer scene.
steps.output: CPU geometry stays shared; graphics handles stay in runtime state.

steps.title: Draw the model
steps.input_title: GPU V + I; camera and G
steps.input: Triangle vertex/index buffers, matrices and appearance
steps.action: Run vertex and fragment work and present the frame.
steps.output: A rendered frame; screenshot capture adds readback.

chapters.title: H. Prepare annotations on a background worker

steps.title: Build blocks and fingerprints
steps.input: The same immutable mesh used by the viewer
steps.action: Reduce bounds in blocks and hash group geometry.
steps.output: 295,985 blocks, up to 256 triangles each; one group fingerprint

steps.title: Create triangle centroid keys
steps.input: Three indexed positions for each triangle
steps.action: Find each centroid and encode its spatial order.
steps.output: 75.772 M pairs; 606.176 MB of populated key payload

steps.title: Sort keys and extract offsets
steps.input: Same-size scratch supports four radix passes.
steps.action: Sort centroid keys, then keep original triangle offsets.
steps.output: 75.772 M offsets; 303.088 MB. Keys and scratch are released.

steps.title: Build triangle search tree
steps.input: Spatial order and the original triangle geometry
steps.action: Build leaf bounds and combine child bounds.
steps.output: 2,097,151 nodes; cache contains B, fingerprints, O/H and a shared geometry owner.

chapters.title: I. Measurement controls, outside production loading

steps.title: Cached read control
steps.input: Disjoint ranges; synchronous 256 KiB reads
steps.action: Read all bytes without parsing.
steps.output: 7,108,991,827 bytes verified; no geometry produced

steps.title: Native read control
steps.input: Aligned reads bypass the Windows file cache.
steps.action: Read all bytes without parsing.
steps.output: Physical-device read control; not cold production parsing

steps.title: Memory copy control
steps.input: 512 MiB; separate 512 MiB destination
steps.action: Copy source to destination 16 times.
steps.output: Contiguous copy calibration; no mesh or indices

steps.title: Probe geometry validation
steps.input: Read positions, UVs, indices and normals after timing.
steps.action: Calculate geometry and normal fingerprints.
steps.output: Verify compared outputs; no new mesh geometry
steps.note: This extra pass is excluded from production load and CPU preparation totals.

buffers.name: Precise source positions
buffers.lifetime: Moved, then shared by MeshGeometry and SourceMeshData; stays on the CPU.

buffers.name: Parsed UV coordinates
buffers.lifetime: Temporary; read by corner mapping and released when the importer returns.

buffers.name: Parsed corner references
buffers.lifetime: Temporary; replaced by I and S, then released.

buffers.name: Parsed face and group metadata
buffers.layout: face sizes, material/smoothing IDs and group boundaries
buffers.lifetime: Temporary per-face records; final group ranges and names are copied into MeshNode metadata.

buffers.name: Render vertices
buffers.lifetime: CPU mesh retains V; GPU gets a copy. Normal generation updates this array in place.

buffers.name: Triangle render indices
buffers.lifetime: CPU and GPU each retain this stream; refers to V.

buffers.name: Triangle source indices
buffers.lifetime: Retained in SourceMeshData on the CPU; refers to P.

buffers.name: Render-to-source map
buffers.lifetime: Retained on the CPU. Precise position of vertex i is P[M[i]].

buffers.name: Overlay point ID-to-vertex map
buffers.lifetime: Moved into Cloud.sourceVertices; retained for CPU picking and source identity.

buffers.name: Point sort keys
buffers.lifetime: Temporary; radix sorting also uses a same-size scratch array.

buffers.name: Spatially ordered point records
buffers.layout: float XYZ + original marker ID; 16 bytes
buffers.lifetime: CPU and GPU retain Q; stored coordinates are not quantized.

buffers.name: Point proxy records
buffers.lifetime: CPU and GPU retain R; sampled original points retain their IDs.

buffers.name: Point hierarchy
buffers.lifetime: CPU tree; guides detail selection, navigation and picking.

buffers.name: Logical group controls
buffers.layout: UiGroupState: bounds, display settings and transforms
buffers.lifetime: UiState retains logical controls on the CPU; runtime converts them to draw parameters.

buffers.name: Annotation triangle blocks
buffers.layout: bounds + index range; 40 bytes; up to 256 triangles
buffers.lifetime: CPU annotation cache; geometry itself is shared.

buffers.name: Annotation centroid keys
buffers.layout: Morton key + original triangle offset; 8 bytes
buffers.lifetime: Temporary; a same-size scratch array is used by radix sorting.

buffers.name: Spatial triangle offsets
buffers.lifetime: CPU annotation cache; preserves original triangle identity.

buffers.name: Annotation spatial tree
buffers.layout: bounds + child and triangle ranges; 72 bytes
buffers.lifetime: CPU annotation cache; prunes triangle searches.
